headline: Tesla has renamed its Full Self-Driving (Supervised) system "Tesla Assisted Driving" in Europe, after talks with Germany's transport ministry.
score_reason: New on 8 Oct; the rename is a small step in a bigger approval story, and the sourcing is a social-media post and a fan site.
importance_line: Drivers across Europe can use the system only if a delayed EU vote approves it; the rename is reported secondhand, Tesla has not confirmed Germany's reported speed cap, and Sweden, France and road-safety groups have raised speeding concerns.
source: Not a Tesla App, citing Sawyer Merritt on X
summary: Not a Tesla App reports, citing a post by Sawyer Merritt on X, that Tesla's European websites now use the new name, a change that follows talks with Germany and that Merritt says should help win EU-wide approval. Germany reportedly also wants Tesla to keep the system from driving more than 10 percent above the speed limit, which Tesla has not confirmed, and the EU-wide vote has slipped from 6 Oct to December at the earliest.
